descriptions.en: IT Map column-browser navigation profiles, templates, stages, transitions, and add actions. Depends on kc-base and archimate-lite. Not part of knowledge-core.
descriptions.cs: IT Map navigační profily (šablony, stage, přechody, add akce). Závisí na kc-base a archimate-lite. Není součástí jádra knowledge-core.

descriptions.en: Not an ArchiMate concept. Root for IT Map navigation / column-browser traversal metadata.
descriptions.cs: Není ArchiMate koncept. Kořen metadat IT Map navigace / column-browser traversal.

classes.usageGuidance: Root for UI traversal profile data. Not used in architecture diagrams.

descriptions.en: IT Map column-browser navigation profile: templates, stages, transitions, and add actions.

classes.usageGuidance: Declares how IT Map traverses the org model. System default lives in archimate-ui-traversal; org packages may override via orgNavigationProfile on package-root.
classes.usageExamples: ui-profile-itmap-default with business-exploration, application-impact, infrastructure templates.

descriptions.en: One selectable traversal path (column layout) within a navigation profile.

classes.usageGuidance: Groups stages, transitions, and add actions for one browser template code.
classes.usageExamples: business-exploration template with organization → facilities stages.

descriptions.en: One column in the traversal browser.

classes.usageGuidance: Defines which ArchiMate classes appear in a column and optional instance filters.
classes.usageExamples: organization stage with BusinessActor and actorKinds=organizationalUnit.

descriptions.en: Edge rule between two stages in a traversal template.

classes.usageGuidance: Maps a relationship class and direction between fromStage and toStage.

descriptions.en: Create-menu action available in a stage.

classes.usageGuidance: Declares what class to create and optional derived relationship when adding from the browser.
classes.usageExamples: add-function creating BusinessFunction with Assignment from selected entity.

properties.usageGuidance: Unique code for the navigation profile.

descriptions.en: Unique stable code identifying a UI navigation profile, e.g. itmap-default.
descriptions.cs: Jedinečný stabilní kód identifikující UI navigační profil, např. itmap-default.

properties.usageGuidance: Semver of the navigation profile content.

descriptions.en: Semantic version of the navigation profile content, e.g. 1.0.0.
descriptions.cs: Sémantická verze obsahu navigačního profilu, např. 1.0.0.

properties.usageGuidance: Minimum archimate-lite catalog version required by this profile.

descriptions.en: Minimum archimate-lite catalog version required by this navigation profile, e.g. 2.3.0.
descriptions.cs: Minimální verze katalogu archimate-lite vyžadovaná tímto navigačním profilem, např. 2.3.0.

properties.usageGuidance: True only for the seeded default profile in archimate-lite.

descriptions.en: True only for the seeded default navigation profile in the archimate-lite package.
descriptions.cs: True pouze u výchozího seedovaného navigačního profilu v balíčku archimate-lite.

properties.usageGuidance: On UiNavigationProfile: optional inheritance. On UiTraversalTemplate: required owning profile.

descriptions.en: Owning or parent UiNavigationProfile for inheritance or template grouping.
descriptions.cs: Vlastnící nebo nadřazený UiNavigationProfile pro dědičnost nebo seskupení šablon.

properties.usageGuidance: Czech label shown in IT Map UI.
properties.usageExamples: IT Map — výchozí navigace; Business exploration.

descriptions.en: Czech label shown in the IT Map user interface.
descriptions.cs: Český popisek zobrazený v uživatelském rozhraní IT Map.

properties.usageGuidance: English label for the navigation profile.

descriptions.en: English label for the navigation profile shown in the IT Map UI.
descriptions.cs: Anglický popisek navigačního profilu zobrazený v UI IT Map.

properties.usageGuidance: Stable code for the traversal template.

descriptions.en: Stable code for a traversal template within a navigation profile, e.g. business-exploration.
descriptions.cs: Stabilní kód traversal šablony v navigačním profilu, např. business-exploration.

properties.usageGuidance: When true, this template is pre-selected in the browser.

descriptions.en: When true, this traversal template is pre-selected when opening the column browser.
descriptions.cs: Pokud true, tato traversal šablona je předvybraná při otevření sloupcového prohlížeče.

properties.usageGuidance: First column of the template. Alternative: lowest stageOrder.

descriptions.en: First column stage of the traversal template; alternatively the stage with the lowest stageOrder.
descriptions.cs: Počáteční stage (sloupec) traversal šablony; alternativně stage s nejnižším stageOrder.

properties.usageGuidance: Ordering in template list or add menu.
properties.usageExamples: 1 for first template; 10 for add action position.

descriptions.en: Ordering position in a template list or add menu, e.g. 1 for the first item.
descriptions.cs: Pořadí v seznamu šablon nebo add menu, např. 1 pro první položku.

properties.usageGuidance: Owning traversal template for this stage, transition, or add action.

descriptions.en: Owning UiTraversalTemplate for this stage, transition, or add action.
descriptions.cs: Vlastnící UiTraversalTemplate pro tuto stage, transition nebo add action.

properties.usageGuidance: Stable code for the stage within a template.

descriptions.en: Stable code for a stage within a traversal template, e.g. organization or applications.
descriptions.cs: Stabilní kód stage v traversal šabloně, např. organization nebo applications.

properties.usageGuidance: Column order (1-based, contiguous).

descriptions.en: Column order within the template (1-based, contiguous), e.g. 1 for the first column.
descriptions.cs: Pořadí sloupce v šabloně (od 1, souvislé), např. 1 pro první sloupec.

properties.usageGuidance: Czech label for the browser column.

descriptions.en: Czech label for the browser column header in IT Map.
descriptions.cs: Český popisek hlavičky sloupce v prohlížeči IT Map.

properties.usageGuidance: ArchiMate element classes shown in this column.

descriptions.en: ArchiMate element classes whose instances are shown in this browser column.
descriptions.cs: Třídy ArchiMate prvků, jejichž instance se zobrazují v tomto sloupci prohlížeče.

properties.usageGuidance: JSON whitelist filter on instance properties (actorKind, organizationScope, ownership, associationKind, accessMode).

descriptions.en: JSON whitelist filter on instance properties, e.g. actorKind, organizationScope, or ownership.
descriptions.cs: JSON whitelist filtr na vlastnostech instance, např. actorKind, organizationScope nebo ownership.

properties.usageGuidance: CSV of actorKind enum values for soft filtering.

descriptions.en: Comma-separated actorKind enum values for soft filtering in a stage, e.g. organizationalUnit or person.
descriptions.cs: CSV hodnot enum actorKind pro měkké filtrování ve stage, např. organizationalUnit nebo person.

properties.usageGuidance: Source column for the transition.

descriptions.en: Source column stage for a UI transition between browser columns.
descriptions.cs: Zdrojová stage (sloupec) pro UI přechod mezi sloupci prohlížeče.

properties.usageGuidance: Target column for the transition.

descriptions.en: Target column stage for a UI transition between browser columns.
descriptions.cs: Cílová stage (sloupec) pro UI přechod mezi sloupci prohlížeče.

properties.usageGuidance: ArchiMate relationship class traversed between stages.

descriptions.en: ArchiMate relationship class traversed when navigating between stages, e.g. Assignment or Serving.
descriptions.cs: Třída ArchiMate vztahu procházená při navigaci mezi stages, např. Assignment nebo Serving.

properties.usageGuidance: model = follow ArchiMate direction; inverse = navigate opposite.

descriptions.en: Whether to follow ArchiMate direction (model) or navigate in reverse (inverse).
descriptions.cs: Zda sledovat směr ArchiMate (model) nebo navigovat opačně (inverse).

properties.usageGuidance: Czech label for the edge in the column browser.

descriptions.en: Czech label for the edge shown in the column browser when traversing between stages.
descriptions.cs: Český popisek hrany zobrazený ve sloupcovém prohlížeči při přechodu mezi stages.

properties.usageGuidance: Optional JSON filter requiring a property value on the relationship.

descriptions.en: Optional JSON filter requiring a specific property value on the traversed relationship.
descriptions.cs: Volitelný JSON filtr vyžadující konkrétní hodnotu vlastnosti na procházeném vztahu.

properties.usageGuidance: Column where this add action is available.

descriptions.en: Browser column where this add action is available in the create menu.
descriptions.cs: Sloupec prohlížeče, kde je tato add action dostupná v create menu.

properties.usageGuidance: Stable code for the add action.

descriptions.en: Stable code for an add action, e.g. add-function or add-app.
descriptions.cs: Stabilní kód add action, např. add-function nebo add-app.

properties.usageGuidance: Czech label shown in the Add menu.

descriptions.en: Czech label shown in the Add menu for this create action.
descriptions.cs: Český popisek zobrazený v Add menu pro tuto create akci.

properties.usageGuidance: ArchiMate class created by this action.

descriptions.en: ArchiMate element class created when the user triggers this add action.
descriptions.cs: Třída ArchiMate prvku vytvořená při spuštění této add action uživatelem.

properties.usageGuidance: JSON Record<string,string> set on the new entity.

descriptions.en: JSON map of property values preset on the newly created entity.
descriptions.cs: JSON mapa hodnot vlastností přednastavených na nově vytvořené entitě.

properties.usageGuidance: Optional relationship created between selected and new entity.

descriptions.en: Optional ArchiMate relationship class created between the selected and new entity.
descriptions.cs: Volitelná třída ArchiMate vztahu vytvořená mezi vybranou a novou entitou.

properties.usageGuidance: Direction of the derived relationship relative to selection.

descriptions.en: Direction of the derived relationship relative to the selection, e.g. from-selected-to-new.
descriptions.cs: Směr odvozeného vztahu vůči výběru, např. from-selected-to-new nebo from-new-to-selected.

properties.usageGuidance: JSON properties set on the derived relationship.

descriptions.en: JSON map of property values preset on the derived relationship entity.
descriptions.cs: JSON mapa hodnot vlastností přednastavených na odvozené entitě vztahu.

properties.usageGuidance: On org package-root: active IT Map navigation profile for the organization.

descriptions.en: On an organization package-root: the active IT Map navigation profile for that organization.
descriptions.cs: U package-root organizace: aktivní IT Map navigační profil pro danou organizaci.
